_: Row/column grips of a Notion 'Table' block. Measured over CDP on the 2026-08-28 table test page, colors checked from full-screenshot pixels. The pixel blue differs from the CSS value because the capture is P3-encoded, so the CSS values are recorded.

line._: Gray line visible only while the pointer is inside the table. Column lines sit centered on the table's top edge, row lines on its left edge.

ring._: 2px white border around the line — makes it look like it cuts the table rule

showsFor: the column and row of the cell under the pointer
the column and row of the **top-left cell** of a cell-range selection (not everything the range spans)
a row/column picked with a grip shows only that grip (row grip for a row selection, column grip for a column selection)
nothing lights up with just a caret

button._: Hovering the line turns it into a 6-dot button. aria-label is '열 이동'/'행 이동' (Move column / Move row) — it is also the handle you drag to reorder (reordering was out of scope this time).

click._: One press selects that whole column/row (a single 2px rgb(39,131,222) border), turns the button blue, and opens the dropdown.

height._: the row menu has a 'Last edited' line at the bottom, so it is 53 taller

headerItem._: The header toggle exists **only in the grip menus of the first row and first column** (the col 1 menu has 6 items). The col 0 grip toggle makes the first **column** a header, the row 0 grip toggle the first **row**. Notion labels both '제목 행' (Header row), verbatim.
headerItem.label: 제목 행

ours._: Notion tables have no alignment — the column menu has 7 items and menu search has no '정렬' (Align) (measured). We added it **on purpose** at the user's request. Do not delete it to restore parity. The measured lists below stay as measured; comparisons assemble measured + ours.

submenu._: Uses the same box as the `색` (Color) submenu (220 wide · radius 10 · items 212×28 · pitch 29 · preview tile 26).
submenu.title: 정렬
submenu.storage: TableData.align cell grid, left when absent. The markdown mirror can only express per-column alignment, so it uses each column's first-row value.

noCellFill._: Selecting cells by dragging leaves the cell background white — confirmed 3 times from full-screenshot pixels in a clean state (inside of selected cells 100% white). The light blue fill #E4EDFA appears only when the table is selected as a block (a sweep starting from the margin).

lit._: Only a drag of 3+ cells tells 'whole range' from 'top-left + hover' apart. With 2×2 both rules give the same answer, which is how it was misread at first. cols/rows read from left/top, 1 = lit, 0 = off.

move._: Dragging a grip moves the row/column. That is why the aria-label is '열 이동'/'행 이동' (Move column / Move row).
move.threshold: the indicator appears only once the pointer leaves the original row/column (nothing shown on the same spot)

ghost._: A copy of the dragged row/column follows the pointer. Columns move only in x, rows only in y; the other axis stays put.

dropBar._: Bar marking the drop position. Moving forward: the end (right/bottom) edge of the target; moving back: its start (left/top) edge.

move.commit: spliced to the target index; the moved row/column stays selected

colorSubmenu._: Second panel that opens beside the `색` (Color) row on hover. 10 text colors + 10 background colors.
colorSubmenu.ours: Values use this app's own palette (globals.css .c-* / .hl-*) — 1–3 RGB off the measured values, and dark mode already exists.

headerCell._: How a header cell looks. Plain cells: no background + 400.
headerCell.followsPosition: a table property, so it sticks to the position — delete the first row and the new first row becomes the header; move the first column and the new first column does

newTable._: a table newly inserted via `표` (Table) in the slash menu
